description: Standing query, zero results expected: the operator's standing read-only role made no successful change in the last three days beyond its declared ones -- starting and stopping an elevation, and starting and stopping Athena queries. Privileged action happens only under an elevation. api.read_only and metadata.event_category exist from 2026-10-07 00:25 UTC (DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-06), so the window fills over the following three days.

params.query: SELECT dt, api.service.name AS service, api.operation AS operation, count(*) AS events FROM normalized_events WHERE source='aws' AND dt >= date_format(date_add('day', -2, current_date), '%Y-%m-%d') AND status = 'Success' AND api.read_only = false AND regexp_like(coalesce(actor.user.name, ''), 'assumed-role/AWSReservedSSO_OperatorReadOnly_[0-9a-f]+/') AND api.operation NOT IN ('StartExecution', 'StopExecution', 'StartQueryExecution', 'StopQueryExecution') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 50

matrix_rows.gap: AWS only. The standing role's changes are held to its declared lane; the elevated role's sessions, which outlive their assignment by up to an hour, are not correlated with grant windows.
